name: Navigo PDF
description: Open PDFs in Navigo's document workspace in Chrome, with local editing and optional Navi AI.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http: https: file: blob: data:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self' blob:; base-uri 'none'
